diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because no rollouts passed any content checks, meaning the model was unable to resolve any of the decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, PF4) using only the shared public information. While this technically means there is no 'leak' where a lone agent solves the scenario, the failure indicates that the decisive facts are too disconnected from the shared context (S1, S2) for a single agent to even attempt a logical inference, or the requirements for passing are so specific that they cannot be met without explicit multi-agent communication.

fix_instructions: To make this a valid multi-agent test, ensure that the shared facts (S1, S2) provide enough context for a lone agent to make *incorrect* or *incomplete* guesses for checks C1 through C6. For example, if S1/S2 suggest a standard voting window, the model might guess 9:00-10:00 PM; you must then ensure that only the private fact PF3 (fixing it to 9:27-9:39 PM) allows the check C3 to pass. Currently, the gap between shared facts and decisive facts is so large that the model defaults to 'Not specified' or generic values, resulting in zero passes across all rollouts.
